offer.text: I've forged a new blade and a smith's word means nothing — it's the field that proves steel. Take it out and put down six of the undead, then tell me how it held.

accept.text: Mind the edge. Report back honest, now.

decline.text: Then it hangs untested on the rack. A pity.

in_progress.text: How does the blade bite? Six of them, remember.

ready.text: Six undead and the edge still keen? Then I forged true.

complete.text: Proven steel and a proven arm. Keep the blade — you've earned it twice over.
